system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Nora Blake launched Remote Desktop from WS-NBLAKE-01 targeting DC-NWD-01; the workstation resolved the domain controller to 10.40.20.10 and initiated a TCP connection to port 3389.

The RDP attempt is anomalous relative to the provided inventory and IT practices, which state that remote administration is only performed from WS-SOKAFOR-01; the records establish an attempt, not a successful session or its purpose.

The available workstation records show Nora running a basic process-listing PowerShell command and launching ChromeSetup.exe, followed later by Firefox browsing to Bing; these records alone do not establish malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: Both winsec and Sysmon collection on DC-NWD-01 was unavailable from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC due to a collection outage, overlapping the reported account-creation time and the observed RDP attempt.
The supplied event records do not include domain-controller account-management events or records showing activity within the RDP session.
claims_not_established: The available records do not establish whether ext.rwong was created, who created it, or when it was created.
The available records do not establish ext.rwong's group membership, privileges, or whether the account was used.
The available records do not establish whether the RDP connection succeeded, which credentials were used, or what actions occurred on DC-NWD-01.
The evidence does not establish whether the RDP attempt was authorized or whether the reported account creation was malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain DC-NWD-01 account-management and authentication logs from another source or recover the missing winsec and Sysmon data for 13:30–14:10 UTC; check for creation and changes to ext.rwong.
Review domain account and group audit records, including the account's group membership and any privilege assignments.
Determine whether the RDP attempt resulted in a session and retrieve relevant domain-controller logon, session, and process activity.
Confirm with the help desk and IT whether Nora Blake's RDP attempt and the reported temporary-account request were authorized.
